summary: NullPointerException in Mailer.sendMail(Email) when the Mailer(Session) constructor is used

comments.content:
When calling

	new org.codemonkey.simplejavamail.Mailer(mySession).sendMail(myEmail);

the following exception occurrs:

	Exception in thread "main" java.lang.NullPointerException
		at org.codemonkey.simplejavamail.Mailer.logSession(Mailer.java:260)
		at org.codemonkey.simplejavamail.Mailer.sendMail(Mailer.java:238)
		at MyClientCode

This is because Mailer.logSession(Session, TransportStrategy) tries to access members of the TransportStrategy, which was never initialized by the Mailer(Session) constructor.
When will this issue (7) be completed?  Is it being worked on?  My development project depends on this issue being fixed or I will have to consider a different code path than the use of this project.
